Mod.Name: More Girls
Mod.Author: 清明葬花祭|lapismind
Mod.Description: Original characters. Store visitors: milk seller, vampire, elf, dark elf, mummy, angel, zombie, wandering swordswoman, cheerleader, ninja, idol, oni girl, slime, Miss Christmas, fairy, thief, shrine maiden, Taoist; rare visitors: fortune teller, green-cloak girl. Wild and dream: magical girl, succubus, goddess. Wonderland branches: Lair (dragon girl), Depths (mermaid), Inn (fox spirit), Foreign Realm (princess), Forest (flower fairy). Works on its own; All Girls is not required. Explore them yourself.
